v=Number(x);return Number.isFinite(v)?v:d}var G=N(sc.G_n_m2_kg2,0),M=N(sc.central_mass_kg,0),g=N(sc.g_m_s2,0),m=N(sc.mass_kg,0),r=N(sc.radius_m,0),v0=N(sc.speed_m_s,0),mode=sc.mode||'uniform';var state(th){var c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th),x,y,v,ac,ax,ay,rf,tn,K,U,me,tm;if(mode==='vertical_string'){x=r*s;y=-r*c;U=m*g*r*(1-c);var v2=v0*v0-2*g*r*(1-c);if(v2<0){v2=0}v=Math.sqrt(v2);ac=accFor(v);tm=ac+g*c;tn=m*tm;ax=-tm*s;ay=tm*c-g;rf=m*ac;K=0.5*m*v*v;me=K+U}else if(mode==='orbit'){v=orbitV();ac=accFor(v);x=r*c;y=r*s;ax=-ac*c;ay=-ac*s;rf=m*ac;tn=0;K=0.5*m*v*v;U=r>0?-G*M*m/r:0;me=K+U}else{v=v0;ac=accFor(v);x=r*c;y=r*s;ax=-ac*c;ay=-ac*s;rf=m*ac;tn=0;K=0.5*m*v*v;U=0;me=K}return{angle_rad:th,x_m:x,y_m:y,speed_m_s:v,ax_m_s2:ax,ay_m_s2:ay,radial_force_n:rf,tension_n:tn,kinetic_j:K,potential_j:U,mechanical_j:me}}var vo=orbitV();cent=accFor(vo);period=vo>0?2*Math.PI*r/vo:null;ev={period_s:period,centripetal_acceleration_m_s2:cent}}else if(mode==='vertical_string'){cent=accFor(v0);var ok=true,n=8192,hh=2*Math.PI/n,sum=0;for(var i=0;i<=n;i++){var th=i*hh,c=Math.cos(th),v2=v0*v0-2*g*r*(1-c);if(!(r>0&&v2>0)){ok=false;break}var
